hero.title: Janardan Rai Nagar Rajasthan Vidyapeeth
hero.summary: Rajasthan Vidyapeeth’s School of Agricultural Sciences operates at Dabok near Udaipur. Its course list spans undergraduate agriculture, specialist postgraduate study and agricultural research. The school’s stated priorities include crop management, postharvest value addition and knowledge transfer to farming communities in southern Rajasthan.

overview.heading: Agricultural education with a southern Rajasthan focus
paragraphs: The School of Agricultural Sciences is based at the university’s Dabok campus, rather than simply sharing the central administrative address in Udaipur. Its published teaching objectives address crop and pest management, preventing postharvest losses and taking agricultural knowledge to farming communities. These priorities provide useful context for applicants interested in extension as well as production science.

The official school page lists B.Sc. Agriculture, several M.Sc. Agriculture and Horticulture specialisations, an agribusiness MBA and doctoral study. These are distinct awards with different academic entry points. The published postgraduate list includes crop production, plant health, agricultural economics, extension and livestock management, together with fruit, vegetable and ornamental horticulture.

faqs.question: Where does the School of Agricultural Sciences teach?
faqs.answer: The official school page locates it at Dabok, near Udaipur. The university’s administrative contact address is a separate reference.

faqs.question: Is the B.Sc. Agriculture entry date-valid in the audited ICAR list?
faqs.answer: Yes. The listed term runs from 11 October 2022 to 10 October 2027.

faqs.question: Can students study fruit science after a bachelor’s degree?
faqs.answer: The school lists a two-year M.Sc. Horticulture in Fruit Science. Its current entrance conditions should be obtained separately.

faqs.question: Does the school list a business qualification?
faqs.answer: Yes. A two-year MBA Agribusiness Management appears in the official school course list.

faqs.question: Can the annual fee on the enquiry page be treated as a 2026-27 quotation?
faqs.answer: No. The page shows INR 84,000 annually for undergraduate agriculture without an academic year; a dated schedule is needed.
